functional.text: Park: at an entrance a vehicle is assigned a free space that fits it and receives a ticket; it is refused when nothing fits.
Leave: at an exit the ticket is scanned, the fee is computed from duration and space size, paid, and the space is freed.
Vehicle types: motorcycle fits any space, car needs regular or large, truck needs large.
Each entrance display shows free spaces per size (availability).

non_functional.text: Several gates work at the same time: a space is never handed to two vehicles.
Open to change: new tariffs, allocation rules or vehicle types should not require editing the core classes.

assumptions.text: 3 levels × ~200 spaces; sizes SMALL, REGULAR, LARGE.
Hourly rate per space size, partial hours rounded up.

out_of_scope.text: Reservations, valet, EV charging, the real payment provider.

api.notes: Called by an EntryGate; picks a space through the allocation strategy and claims it atomically.
Called by an ExitGate; fee from the pricing strategy, then the space is released.

data.name: ParkingSpot
data.fields: id, level, size: SpotSize, vehicle: Vehicle | None
data.why: The unit of occupancy; it alone knows if it is free.

data.name: Ticket
data.fields: id, vehicle, spot, entered_at, exited_at?, fee?
data.why: Remembers the stay so the exit can charge it.

data.name: Vehicle
data.fields: plate; size() returns the smallest size it needs (Car, Motorcycle, Truck)
data.why: Each vehicle states the smallest space it needs.

data.name: Level
data.why: Groups spaces and keeps per-size free lists for O(1) lookup.

deep_dives.title: Spot allocation

options.name: if/else inside ParkingLot.park
options.cons: every new rule edits the facade

options.name: SpotAllocationStrategy interface
options.pros: rules are swappable and testable alone

deep_dives.choice: SpotAllocationStrategy with a best-fit default (smallest size that fits, nearest level first)
deep_dives.why: Best fit keeps large spaces for trucks; the strategy keeps ParkingLot closed to modification when the garage wants, say, nearest-to-elevator.

deep_dives.title: Fee calculation

options.name: Ticket computes its own fee
options.cons: tariff logic tied to the ticket

options.name: PricingStrategy
options.pros: weekend or flat tariffs are new classes

deep_dives.why: Pricing changes far more often than parking does; isolating it follows SRP and OCP.

wrapup.bottlenecks: Finding a free space by scanning 600 spaces; fixed with per-level, per-size free lists.
wrapup.failures: Payment failure leaves the ticket open and the barrier closed; a lost ticket falls back to a max-day fee by plate lookup.
wrapup.monitoring: Occupancy per size, refusals, average stay, revenue per day.
wrapup.scale: Gates run concurrently: a space is claimed under a per-size lock (or compare-and-set on spot.vehicle) so it is never assigned twice. More levels are more Level objects; a new vehicle kind is a new subclass and possibly a new SpotSize value.
wrapup.future: Reservations (a Reservation that holds a spot for a window), EV spaces as a SpotSize or a feature flag on ParkingSpot.
